name: Sheraton Grand Tbilisi Metechi Palace
positioning: City-center hotel in Tbilisi, open since 1991, with panoramic views of the city, the Old Town and Narikala fortress, a lobby designed around Georgian style and culture, and the P'auza spa with an indoor pool, grotto and ice pool
best_for: City travelers who want views of the Old Town and Narikala fortress, a short walk to Old Tbilisi and minutes to Abanotubani
Couples and wellness-minded guests who want a spa with an indoor pool, grotto and ice pool and a Couple Luxury Suite experience

facts.text: Old Tbilisi is a short walk from the hotel.
The hotel has welcomed locals and international travelers since 1991.
Many of the rooms and suites have private balconies, and they offer panoramic views of the historic skyline.
Glass elevators ride up through the hotel's 10-story atrium.
The hotel is just minutes from the Bridge of Peace, which connects Old Tbilisi with the new district.
P'auza Spa uses Germaine de Capuccini products in its face and body treatments.
The spa's name draws on Tsutisopeli, which means life is just a minute, inviting guests to pause from the rush of life.
The spa's Couple Luxury Suite experience pairs a couple's massage with time in a private jacuzzi with snacks and wine.
The Presidential Suite has a separate living room, dining room and lounge area with panoramic views of Old Tbilisi.
The Royal Suite has a kitchen, a living space, a salon for private meetings or dining, and a balcony with a mountain view.
The Club lounge has a terrace with panoramic views over Old Tbilisi.
ATI is a rooftop restaurant, bar and lounge on the 10th floor serving modern interpretations of classic Georgian specialties with city views.

highlights.text: The hotel has panoramic views of the city and the Old Town.
The hotel's views of Tbilisi overlook Narikala fortress and the Mtkvari River, with mountains around the city.
The hotel is just minutes from Abanotubani, the ancient district of Tbilisi known for its sulphur baths.
The P'auza spa facilities include an indoor pool, plunge pool, grotto, ice pool, steam room and sauna, plus a spacious relaxation area.
The lobby design incorporates Georgian style and culture, from historic pattern weaves in the carpets to a Caravanserai courtyard.

considerations.text: Metechi Bridge, at the foot of Narikala fort, is a 10-minute walk from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
